feature_contract.goal: Keep the R84 frame stereo completion and accepted HUD/world producer latches truthful after all GPU left/right submissions and state restoration, so failed right-eye draws cannot be recorded as successful stereo output.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R30 lower and R33 final R84 game renderers only; preserve left game HRESULT, current-frame right-eye failure veto and recovery safety, SkyGlow/world visual owner, external F11, R26_SAFE, DX11 and frozen DXVK.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Source-confirmed runtime correctness defect: R29OwnerRecordWorldStereoDuplicate and R29OwnerRecordHudStereoDuplicate set FrameHadDuplicatedDraw and FrameHadWorldStereo before R30/R33 check rightHr or restoreOk. This advertises an incomplete stereo draw as complete despite downstream frame failure veto.
trace_stages: Original D3D9 Draw and source HUD/world producer arrive in the R30 or R33 stereo dispatcher for two-eye GPU submission.
After successful left draw, right SetRenderTarget/viewport/c64/Draw and restoration independently return rightHr and restoreOk, which can fail even though the left game HRESULT was successful.

Before source repair, RecordWorldStereoDuplicate/RecordHudStereoDuplicate stamped per-frame duplicate and pose status unconditionally; the new gate publishes completion only on both successful HRESULTs and successful state restore.
subcomponents: Correct complete two-eye admission in both R30 XYZRHW and R30 HUD fallback paths without changing failure recovery or geometry.
Correct R33 primary fast world and screen HUD admission and stable telemetry, with a portable all-eight-combinations predicate regression.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 R30/R33 frame duplicate and world HUD pose state
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: GPU left and right draw plus restoration all succeed before either path asserts completed binocular duplicate/pose evidence.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R30/R33 GPU HRESULT and renderer state restore
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Any failed right-eye submission or failed restore does not publish completed binocular status; existing failure poisoning and returned original left draw HRESULT remain unchanged.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 Windows x86 game plus host x64 package and Domain/Inspector/Full Source
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All required GitHub Actions pass on the same validation-bearing commit before BUILD_VERIFIED, with HMD runtime validation separately untested.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R30 and R33 unconditionally invoke the World/HUD duplicate admission counters after the right-eye GPU submission block and before testing FAILED(rightHr) or !restoreOk.
diagnosis.root_cause: R84 duplicate and stable-frame admission was placed before final right-eye HRESULT and render-state restoration verification.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Both fallback R30 pathways and primary R33 pathways now condition world/HUD frame latching and successful binocular telemetry on CanPublishStereoDraw(left,right,restored).
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Shared constexpr admission contract has all success and failure static assertions; portable smoke enumerates 2x2x2 GPU/restore permutations.
diagnosis.evidence_limits: No Quest3/VDXR runtime or live GPU fault injection; evidence is source and static/portable tests pending exact-SHA CI.
source_trace: Left GPU draw is issued under the original R30/R33 caller and returns the game's left-eye HRESULT.
Right GPU draw and state-restoration status are collected independently before the original right-eye failure veto.
World/HUD duplicate and pose evidence are now recorded only after successful right-eye GPU completion and restoration.
alternatives_rejected: This is not a new stereo transform, world/F11 semantic tag or lens flare producer repair; the observed incorrect frame-completion placement is explicit in the code.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: R84 renders left/backbuffer then right/per-eye RT; both physically successful draws and restored D3D state are now necessary to claim binocular completion.

runtime_evidence: Quest3/VDXR not executed in this task.
